cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Come paint the old kitchen with me. Since Dad died, I barely see you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay someone. I can't face painting over his height marks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We'll keep them. Come help me tape around them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probably just sit on the floor and cry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll sit with you. We can leave the paint unopened; I don't want us only meeting to empty his house.

mechanism: A uses confident painting expertise to adapt a shared task around B grief, insisting on B presence because their sibling connection matters more than finishing the work.
confusable: D74 keeps someone already present until repair; D73 recruits showing up or help as proof of continuing connection.
comparison: Opening alternative arranges father attendance around divorce; kitchen alternative changes work around shared bereavement without abandoning the invitation.
seedUse: Dad height marks, kitchen painting, grief and unopened paint derive from D73-a; S03 adds exact preservation and preparation instructions.
